name: Pythagoras
source:
A mysterious scholar. She is often seen in the Library of Alexandria, so her affiliation is said to be Macedonia, but her birthplace is unknown.

She has her own information network, and knows things that only a few ancient heroes know. However, it's unclear whether she really knows them or is just pretending to know them. Her hobby seems to be "unraveling the secrets of the world."
